name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for electronics and amateur radio as a child. After earning a degree in electrical engineering, he honed his skills in the automotive industry before transitioning to the world of racing. He is known for his methodical approach to problem-solving and his ability to quickly diagnose and resolve electrical issues, even under pressure.

Jean-Pierre joined JOTA Sport five years ago, bringing with him a wealth of experience and a reputation for reliability. He approaches his role with a blend of technical expertise and practical common sense, always seeking the most efficient and effective solution. While not one to seek the spotlight, his dedication and attention to detail are invaluable assets to the team.

His colleagues value his calm demeanor and willingness to share his knowledge. He is particularly adept at training junior engineers, ensuring they grasp the fundamentals of motorsport electronics and develop a similar, pragmatic approach to their work.

physical.description: A man of average height, he carries himself with a quiet confidence.

quirks: Always carries a small multi-tool in his pocket.
Drinks black coffee precisely every two hours.
Meticulously labels every cable and connection.
